## #152 completion receipt — Company Tax capability

PR #213 merged through the protected Release gate into `5b74340ca75f215b43d754c6bf0fc49ef5974b0b`, whose tree exactly matches final reviewed head `0b2d5ea8cfc4397e9dcf7203b886737c61a5ce09` (`0e456c20064ba10879f44390e3cb6b06165dd8a1`). Final-head [Release gate](https://github.com/kristianelmer/Talli/actions/runs/34808139123) and exact-main [Release gate](https://github.com/kristianelmer/Talli/actions/runs/34809460472) passed Application, Database isolation and Release gate. The conditional workflow-dispatch evidence job was intentionally skipped. Actual job checkout commits and trees were independently verified. Final-head Preview `dpl_DUAYcrP1yaymFFu4dvNaVn7asS1y` and exact-main Preview `dpl_HHknHEG8DWvuga54BPVGTcoyQtbv` are READY and bound to those exact revisions; both are Preview deployments.

Final-head CI actually checked out `3cf6e84c94e5879aac51abbe241d65abea83d6ee`; both exact-main jobs checked out `5b74340ca75f215b43d754c6bf0fc49ef5974b0b`. Both checkout trees are `0e456c20064ba10879f44390e3cb6b06165dd8a1`. Private complete CI transcript SHA-256 bindings: head `b9d12a408b384a89b3cd899e4c49364bc52fea716e3a03f16d314f75d2d2f453`, main `09b9271de7209a523f6ef2cc766ba15f907e51cc47cdca80033d38d5affe8206`. The bounded integration verification SHA-256 is `c680ee1ef62e9bfd1df3a33ddf74f59c3afd67af51267e52a69b3d7b1f8b0d5c`.

Two new consecutive complete immutable gates passed:

- [7c9b3caae3cd278bbe381589308cf302142b58a5](https://github.com/kristianelmer/Talli/blob/0b2d5ea8cfc4397e9dcf7203b886737c61a5ce09/architecture/evidence/customer-ready-gates/7c9b3caae3cd278bbe381589308cf302142b58a5.json): 11/11, 2026-09-14 04:14:02.889Z–04:33:51.099Z; canonical digest `sha256:799bb21ece9c29531535f128df0a2880afe59d8d2ded374990f3e47b181f0e94`; transcript `sha256:c0a6774d82439cafbc528bf5996955a3017e3aeb7dd8c197b6a7f15b144d8622`.
- [a20b1065163ee8ddb2cf1bb6e29d7d3cf8d1d3a2](https://github.com/kristianelmer/Talli/blob/0b2d5ea8cfc4397e9dcf7203b886737c61a5ce09/architecture/evidence/customer-ready-gates/a20b1065163ee8ddb2cf1bb6e29d7d3cf8d1d3a2.json): 11/11, 2026-09-14 04:35:03.140Z–04:54:39.950Z; explicitly links the first; canonical digest `sha256:ca2dabdfd37b8d717f82ec427bbcccf3372f82508a5d14407ab3742825afb073`; transcript `sha256:b298c307c93e11ac3d16afcad13da664113766247f3195f0893e7fd6582f5212`.

Both bind the tested producer digest `sha256:0528b969d8d715a8276aa93beb0d30dc2879c5ee270ce7726fcd2e152cd3253c`. [Independent Spec](https://github.com/kristianelmer/Talli/blob/0b2d5ea8cfc4397e9dcf7203b886737c61a5ce09/architecture/evidence/issues/152/gate-pair/gate-pair-spec-review-152.md) and [Standards](https://github.com/kristianelmer/Talli/blob/0b2d5ea8cfc4397e9dcf7203b886737c61a5ce09/architecture/evidence/issues/152/gate-pair/gate-pair-standards-review-152.md) reviews pass. Their committed-byte reread at final head verified receipts, original criterion text, all adoption hashes and the evidence-only final delta; private reread binding SHA-256: `353cab03d98237a98cb94d20499f48699ee30e28d20ebba47c38fb4003c0c4e2`.

All six original acceptance criteria pass:

1. Supported 2025 calculations, payload/XML and sanitized TT02 results preserve frozen predecessor outputs and official-schema/golden evidence. Genuine archived TT02 bytes remain unchanged; positive synthetic import cases are explicitly separate.
2. Participation-exemption, no-attachment support, ordered readiness feedback and numerical/truth-value boundaries remain deterministic and fail closed.
3. Preparation preserves existing authorization/MFA and Audit continuations. TT02 import preserves atomic Audit inclusion, idempotent receipts, original IDs and ambiguous-response recovery. The preserved human-confirmed authority rehearsal retains confirmation/feedback boundaries; pending TT02 feedback is not authority acceptance.
4. The complete owner-facing Tax workflow uses FastAPI and generated transport; Workspace, Annual and Archive consume owned projections. Real owner/TOTP browsers prove import, replay, revoked membership and settlement capture.
5. Six Tax filing families and settlement records have one canonical owner, count/hash reconciliation and rollback/recutover evidence. Generic Tax writer paths, the legacy facade and duplicate TypeScript policy are removed. The frozen compatibility baseline and sixteen approved Annual sibling tuples remain unchanged until their last source migrates.
6. Full Company Tax local exit and protected integration evidence pass before #153 is claimed. #146 remains the completed settlement predecessor; its entry/exit evidence is not reused as either new #152 exit gate.

Each local gate contains all 32 Tax database cases and six mandatory browser groups (1/24/1/11/12/2 passing tests), with no skips in those groups. Two existing optional backend skips, one optional validation-observation Python skip and 60 nonblocking advisor performance warnings are disclosed; mandatory SQL observation coverage ran. Earlier failed local gates `9f5c5a5b`, `41bcead1`, `ac9b349a`, cancelled `849f81d4` and failed CI 34805023185 have zero pair credit. The annual browser fixture now uses owned Tax permissions, and both Python lockfiles agree on the declared runtime dependencies.

[Exit verification](https://github.com/kristianelmer/Talli/blob/0b2d5ea8cfc4397e9dcf7203b886737c61a5ce09/architecture/evidence/issues/152/verification.md) binds the frozen comparisons, seven filing lifecycle scenarios, transaction races, real owner browsers and 21-check deployment-order protocol matrix. The protocol matrix uses a disposable restored database, real loopback PostgREST, FastAPI and restricted adapters with synthetic claims; real Auth/TOTP is separate browser evidence. It proves both rollback forms, restored predecessor RPC identity, latest receipt replay and re-cutover, without claiming a complete old/new browser deployment.

The immutable source proves coverage of Talli-recorded Tax history and preserves identity/version/digest/time, attribution, unknown outcomes, corrections and source-owned incidents. Missing coverage is unavailable. Current readiness remains decisively blocked by disabled production; it does not certify other stored prerequisites. Future activation must extend that versioned source with durable prerequisite facts. Billing alone applies commercial/refund policy.

No hosted migration, provider activation, genuine filing, paid operation, production promotion or activated-production observation is claimed. Preview is build/revision evidence, not a working hosted backend claim. Production was rechecked at frozen `d331ee2717d1eeacef0d81db42b9d4fb5848b408`, deployment `dpl_HuHzBsgpcgBVTGsFiFLEEy3PqN5f`, READY. This completes #152 and the Company Tax capability; #153 may begin only after independent reread of this published receipt.
